files.description: Repository conventions: multi-module layout, build/test/lint commands, architecture of the Storage interface and helpers, config-builder pattern, documentation-site workflow.
Package-level overview and usage patterns for the Storage API.
The Storage interface, FileInfo/ListResult shapes, sentinel errors, and the shared PutOptions/GetOptions/ListOptions/SignedURLOptions option types every backend implements against.
The linter ruleset already enforced in CI; avoid duplicating what golangci-lint already flags.
Release process (tag root, bump sub-module requires, tag sub-modules) and PR/commit conventions.
